items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: And now that Archie is rather in and out with us

ctx.x: Archie, yes. And now that Archie is rather in and out with us, we have Nick Agniotti, who plays trombone with us now.
Mm-hmm. Yeah, that's Archie Rogers. Right. Now, let's see. As the band grew, what style were you aiming for then?
